class.name: NNSTBranchNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for all State Tree nodes.
class.description: Input events are only delivered to active states. A script on an active state receives them through [method on_input], [method on_unhandled_input] and [method on_unhandled_key_input], or through the engine input virtuals it overrides itself.

method.name: erase_blackboard
method.description: Erases [param key] from the blackboard of the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor. Returns [code]false[/code] when the key is absent or when there is no root.

method.name: get_blackboard
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key] in the blackboard of the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor. Returns [param default] when the key is missing, its value is [code]null[/code], or there is no root. Blackboard keys are always [String]s.

method.name: get_blackboard_resource
method.description: Returns the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor: the board explicitly assigned to that root, or the root's own private board when none is assigned. Returns [code]null[/code] only when there is no [NNSTRoot] ancestor.

method.name: has_blackboard
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param key] exists in the blackboard of the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor and its value is not [code]null[/code]; returns [code]false[/code] otherwise, including when there is no root.

method.name: get_is_active
method.description: Returns if the state is currently active. This is set to [code]true[/code] when the state is entered and [code]false[/code] when exited.

method.name: on_input
method.description: See [method Node._input]. The [member internal_status] property must also be set to `Active` for this function to fire.

method.name: on_unhandled_input
method.description: See [method Node._unhandled_input]. The [member internal_status] property must also be set to `Active` for this function to fire.

method.name: on_unhandled_key_input
method.description: See [method Node._unhandled_key_input]. The [member internal_status] property must also be set to `Active` for this function to fire.

method.name: set_blackboard
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key] in the blackboard of the nearest [NNSTRoot] ancestor. Returns [code]false[/code] when the key is empty or there is no root.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Sends an event to the chart. Events are queued on the [NNSTRoot] and processed one at a time in FIFO order, so calling this from a callback (for example [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_state], [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_exit_state] or a guard) does not process the event recursively. The event is handled after the transition that is running and all of its callbacks have completed, whether that transition came from an event or from a direct [method NNSTTickedNodes.transition_to] call. The event is delivered to the innermost active state first and bubbles up to its ancestors until a state consumes it. A compound state forwards the event to its active child first and only handles it when that child did not. A parallel state forwards the event to every active region. The root is the last state to see the event, so transitions attached directly to the root are only tried when no active child consumed it. Every transition with a matching event name is tried in child order; a transition whose guard fails does not consume the event, so the remaining transitions and the parent states still receive it. Emits [signal NNSTRoot.event_received] on the root and [signal NNSTTickedNodes.event_received] on every state the event is delivered to.

members.member: Defines how the child state is chosen. Can be one of the following: "OnEnterConditionMethod:0,UtilityScoring:1", where "OnEnterConditionMethod" means that the user-defined [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_condition] method is called and if it returns [code]true[/code], the state is selected. "UtilityScoring" option uses the considerations set in the properties of the state and/or as child nodes. The highest-scoring state will be chosen. [b]Note:[/b] This setting has no affect on [NNSTParallel] which will always attempt to enter all children in order.
